why: Academic plagiarism cases are judged by professors, academics, or academic integrity boards.
Oil spill evaluation requires specific scientific expertise in environmental impact.
Cross-border crypto fraud requires both legal/financial regulation expertise and technical blockchain knowledge.
Food safety violations specifically require health inspectors or food safety experts.
Ergonomic injuries require specialists in occupational health or ergonomics.
Liability for an autonomous-vehicle crash needs technical knowledge of autonomous systems (an automotive engineer or AI expert).
Patent infringement of a chip requires legal IP experts and hardware engineers.
A medical malpractice jury requires a medical professional to establish the standard of care.
A DB connection pool exhaustion incident puts database expertise first, and recovery needs SRE/infrastructure expertise somewhere in the list.
Evaluating AI bias requires ML experts or ethicists to understand the algorithmic and societal impacts.
